scraped.scraped_description: On an entry page there are three fields that are filled with user-generated free form text. We call these ‘Open Text’ fields, and they are the Title, Brief Description and Narrative. The rest of the fields are either numbers, dates, or fixed options—we call these ‘Fixed Data’ fields.

name: Participedia
tagline: A global crowdsourcing platform for researchers, activists, practitioners, and anyone interested in public participation and democratic innovations.
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 - Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
known_funders: Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council of Canada (SSHRC)
last_funding_event: 2021 SSHRC Partnership Grant, Phase 2 (2021-2026), ~$2.5 million CAD
academic_citations: Smith (2015) - The Potential of Participedia as a Crowdsourcing Tool for Comparative Analysis of Democratic Innovations, Policy & Internet
outcome_methodology: crowdsourced case documentation; structured comparative data collection
documented_limitations: volunteer contributor quality hard to standardise
governance_model: Academic co-governance led by McMaster University, Simon Fraser University, Harvard University, and University of British Columbia; 63 researchers from 22 universities across 12 countries in Phase 2
curation_criteria: Crowdsourced cases, methods, organisations, and collections related to democratic participation and innovation
contributor_governance: open contribution with editorial oversight by permanent staff
